notes: Selected average rater–whole correlation because original locator PDF p. 4 directly reports .80; the neutral agreement description also encompasses average pairwise inter-rater correlation, which is a different summary (.64 original; .40 Study 1; .59 Study 2). No p values were printed for these descriptive agreement measures, and none was inferred. Original total n is an explicitly author-supplied value in the replication paper, checked against the two original participant samples; no conversion was performed. Study 1 is the small pre-test, retained separately from Study 2. Authors qualify the joint replication verdict by basing main conclusions on Study 2 because Study 1 is small. PDF text parses original equals signs as 5; the quote preserves the frozen parse.
